value.rationale: This is an exact complete dynamic classification of both natural graph-coloring transition rules on the smallest triangle-free four-chromatic graph: it identifies a non-frozen two-component failure of single-vertex mobility and proves Kempe ergodicity with a seven-step bound. The sign action, crossing count, and exact distances are structural/comparative, useful as rigorous benchmarks for constrained color-sampling and reconfiguration; they are not mere relabelings or static chromatic-polynomial evaluations.
